transfer: permanent cation (cholinium): no proton transfer needed
il_like: choline = small but very asymmetric, flexible, charge on a quaternary N; forms low-melting salts/ILs with many NSAIDs
safety: choline salts on FDA GRAS/SCOGS; pharma-established
lit: NOT FOUND with choline. Tolfenamic acid made as API-IL only with lipoamino-acid ester cations.

transfer: permanent cation: no proton transfer needed
il_like: same choline reasoning; closest known drugs ibuprofen/naproxen/ketoprofen form choline and other low-melting salts
lit: NOT FOUND with choline. Loxoprofen IL made with matrine; loxoprofen diisopropanolamine salt in a patent.
source: Matrine: RSC Adv. 2025, DOI 10.1039/d4ra08188a; diisopropanolamine: US8623387B2 (MedRx, 2014)

transfer: permanent cation: no proton transfer needed
il_like: choline reasoning; mefenamate (very similar drug) is the closest known user
lit: ALREADY EXISTS as a 1:1 crystalline choline-meclofenamate salt (X-ray). Reported as a crystal, not as a liquid/IL.
source: Dhanaraj & Vijayan, Biochim. Biophys. Acta 1987, 924(1):135-146, DOI 10.1016/0304-4165(87)90080-8

transfer: permanent cation: no proton transfer needed
il_like: choline reasoning; etodolac already forms ILs with amino-acid-ester and alkanolamine cations
lit: NOT FOUND with choline. Etodolac IL made with proline ethyl ester; etodolac diisopropanolamine salt in a patent.
source: Proline ethyl ester: Eur. J. Pharm. Sci. 2022, 178:106290; diisopropanolamine: US8623387B2

il_like: docusate = big, very flexible, charge-spread anion; the classic anion for low-melting API-ILs
safety: docusate: GRAS/SCOGS tier A (approved stool-softener excipient)
lit: NOT FOUND. Docusate API-ILs well established (e.g. lidocainium docusate), so the pairing is on solid ground.
source: Hough et al., New J. Chem. 2007, 31(8):1429-1436

il_like: docusate reasoning; closest users are chlorpromazine/promethazine (similar tricyclic amines)
lit: NOT FOUND. Same docusate API-IL basis as above.
source: Hough et al., New J. Chem. 2007, 31(8):1429-1436

il_like: salicylate = small, rigid, but charge delocalised; forms room-temperature-liquid salts with related local anaesthetics
lit: NOT FOUND for mepivacaine. Lidocaine salicylate and tetracainium salicylate are liquids at room temperature (close analogues).
source: Panic et al., RSC Adv. 2020, 10:14089, DOI 10.1039/c9ra08815f; Rapaic et al., RSC Adv. 2022, DOI 10.1039/d2ra04711j

il_like: salicylate reasoning; dibucaine is a local anaesthetic like lidocaine/tetracaine
lit: NOT FOUND for dibucaine. Same local-anaesthetic-salicylate analogue family as above.
source: Panic et al., RSC Adv. 2020; Rapaic et al., RSC Adv. 2022

il_like: linoleate = long, very flexible fatty-acid anion -> strongly lowers melting point; good IL former
lit: NOT FOUND with linoleate. Chlorpromazine ibuprofenate IL reported (shows chlorpromazine forms API-ILs).
source: Chlorpromazine ibuprofenate: Perry et al., PSRC (TN Tech) / Select 2018, DOI 10.1002/slct.201801296

il_like: lysinate cation is biocompatible; amino-acid cations give biocompatible API-ILs but do not always melt low
lit: NOT FOUND as a warfarin-lysine salt/IL. Warfarin is normally used as the sodium salt.

il_like: arginine cation biocompatible; same caution as lysine on actually melting low
lit: NOT FOUND with arginine. Levothyroxine ILs made with choline and a hydroxyethyl-methylimidazolium cation (not arginine).
source: Barreira et al., Int. J. Mol. Sci. 2023, 24:8822, DOI 10.3390/ijms24108822

il_like: diethanolamine cation: small, flexible, H-bonding; known to give soluble ibuprofen salts
lit: ALREADY EXISTS: ibuprofen diethanolamine salt is patented (more soluble form).

il_like: mesylate: small, pharma-standard salt anion; usually a solid salt, not an IL
lit: NOT FOUND for albendazole mesylate. Albendazole besylate/tosylate/oxalate salts reported (close analogues); mebendazole mesylate exists.
